svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two rails 800 mm long, 480 mm apart (centres), on four legs 260 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tall at the rail ends. Weld legs under the rails, square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two saddles 560 mm long across the rails, 500 mm apart (centres),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: welded on top of the rails. Top of the saddles 340 mm from the floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chocks: four hardwood blocks 40 x 60 mm, inner faces 300 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 70 mm tall on the far saddle, 45 mm tall on the bung-end saddle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the drum falls 2.9 degrees toward its bungs. Screw them down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the drum body rests on the four inner top edges of the chocks,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bung end low and over the tray. Nothing else holds it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Loads: a drum full of water is about 240 kg; 691 N on each chock.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: frame stands level without rocking; the drum, rolled on,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sits on all four chocks and does not roll off sideways.
